versions.changelog:
Initial release of OSS QPS/Bandwidth Quota & Throttling Diagnosis skill.

- Provides read-only diagnosis for OSS QPS/bandwidth quota issues, including persistent 503/SlowDown errors, bandwidth saturation, and timeouts without clear server errors.
- Enforces strict read-only operation: absolutely no mutating OSS actions or direct API calls; all diagnostics run via provided scripts.
- Offers guidance on identifying, attributing, and remediating throttling problems (concurrency, prefix hashing, backoff, quota increase procedures).
- Delivers decisions grounded in script output, official documentation, or user evidence; prohibits fabrication of utilization data.
- Clear routing boundaries: not for single-request error codes, client/network issues, or billing—these are deferred to sibling skills.
- Mandatory documentation verification and explicit doc citation practices are required for all reports.
